name: Uruwashi no Dorei Hime Tiaris ~Nikuyoku no Jutai Settai~
original_name: 麗しの奴隷姫ティアリス～肉欲の受胎接待～
source:
Xizaroff is a King of Deyan who like to devise a stratagem and pillage.

One day, beautiful Queen Tiaris from Louse, a small country comes to ask for the financial support.

Xizaroff proposes a congress which gathers kings from several countries and demand Tiaris to entertain them using her body.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041684.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
吉扎洛夫是迪扬国王，最爱策划阴谋与四处掠夺。

某天，小国劳斯的美丽女王蒂亚莉丝前来寻求经济援助。

吉扎洛夫提议召开一场多国国王齐聚的会议，并要求蒂亚莉丝用自己的身体招待众人。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE041684.html]DLsite English[/url]]
